title: Resolve: Will the bill pass the Senate by Nov 30?
instructions: You resolve a prediction market. Use only the pinned roll-call snapshot and the market rules. A bill has passed the Senate only if the snapshot records a passing roll-call vote dated on or before November 30. If the snapshot does not settle the question, answer UNCLEAR. You never see the market price.

context.content: Example snapshot. Senate roll call votes, 119th Congress, 2nd session, November 2026. Vote 301 (Nov 18): cloture on a nomination, agreed 52-47. Vote 302 (Nov 19): motion to proceed to H.R. 4410, rejected 46-53. No further votes on H.R. 4410 were recorded through November 30.

Market rules. This market resolves YES if H.R. 4410 passes the Senate by 11:59 pm ET on November 30, 2026, per the official Senate roll call record. It resolves NO otherwise. It resolves UNCLEAR only if the record is unavailable.
Resolver policy v2. Name the deciding source before the event. Snapshot it at a set time. Never read the market price or order book. Prefer UNCLEAR to a guess.

question.prompt: Did H.R. 4410 pass the Senate by November 30, 2026?
